purpose: Machine-readable conservative qualification boundaries for composite predicates; no runtime promotion is authorized by this document alone.

domains.normalization: E49 legacy flag and E144 canonical history marker are alternative authored representations of the guild-representation domain; they count as one domain, never two.

non_alias_rules: E165 and E166 are the same market domain
relationship.ivo is not an institutional domain
E49 and E144 cannot be counted as two independent domains

pred.coalition_cooperation.source_semantics: E148-A records the mutual-concession coalition package and explicitly records participation from Mara, Rowan, Seris, Ivo, Amara and Toma.
pred.coalition_cooperation.qualification_rule: E148-A package exists AND at least 3 distinct recorded participant identities qualify as cooperating factions AND no unresolved coalition-collapse marker is active
non_alias_rules: E261 four_way_bargain is support evidence only
relationship strength alone is not factional cooperation
history.cross_faction_package is the canonical source marker

non_circularity: E209 ratification outputs cannot satisfy its own trigger
E210 convergence cannot backfill missing prerequisites
pred.final_charter_prerequisites.authoring_gap: The catalog specifies the qualification categories but does not yet assign one authoritative producer/key for the composite predicate. Do not infer a producer from E209 itself.

global_non_circularity: consumer cannot create the predicate it consumes
trigger text is not evidence by itself
relationship values are not institutional domains
downstream consequences cannot become upstream prerequisites by narrative implication
one authored source cannot count as multiple independent domains without explicit canonical proof
